title: Privacy Policy
intro: Your privacy is important to me. This website is built with a privacy-first approach and does not track you.
content:
1. No Cookies & No Tracking
This website does not set any tracking cookies, analytics pixels, or advertising trackers. No personal data is collected or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

2. Hosting & Server Logs
This site is hosted on Vercel Inc. (440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA). When you access this website, the server automatically collects technical log files strictly to ensure security, stability, and fast content delivery (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).

3. Direct Communication
If you contact me via email, the information you provide will only be used to process your inquiry and for subsequent communication.

4. Your Rights
Under the GDPR, you have the right to information, correction, deletion, and restriction of processing of any personal data stored by us. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Österreichische Datenschutzbehörde, www.dsb.gv.at).
